title: Claude unlocks AI power with four MCPs expanding research, browsing #ClaudeAI #MCPs #AItools
description: Claude expanded its capabilities with four essential MCPs: Perplexity, Fire Crawl, Playwright, and Context Seven. These plugins enable advanced AI research access, live web data gathering, browser automation, and real-time tool documentation integration. By installing these MCPs, Claude moves beyond basic functionality to deliver comprehensive data insights, competitor analysis, and seamless interaction with external tools. This unlocks the AI’s full potential, making it a powerful assistant for complex workflows. The integration of these MCPs reflects a shift toward more dynamic, interconnected AI systems that leverage real-time web and tool access to enhance productivity and accuracy. Comment “plugs” to get a single prompt for instant installation and unleash your AI’s full power. #ClaudeAI #Perplexity #FireCrawl #Playwright #ContextSeven #AIplugins #AIAutomation #AIAssistant #AItools #MCPIntegration #WebScrapingAI #BrowserAutomation #ResearchAI #CompetitorAnalysis #AIproductivity
